usage: The word '手臂' is a noun referring specifically to the arms, the part of the body between the shoulder and the wrist.
'手臂' can be used to describe both the physical appearance and function of the arms.
You can use '手臂' when talking about exercises or actions involving your arms.
In everyday speech, '手臂' often appears in contexts related to health, fitness, or physical description.
It can be used with quantifiers like '條' (tiu4) to count the arms.
